_readme: Pages moved off their computed release day, and hubs that are not being built (both read by scripts/god-build-plan.mjs). Oct 16, 2026: the owner asked to publish the 37 fact-checked tick pages now instead of Nov 16, after the 86 North American guides reached 85% indexed in their first week. Later on Oct 16: the 12 build-wave-1 pages of data/god-build/next-50.json are dated that day, so each goes live the morning after its fact-check is committed and pushed. Also on Oct 16: the 13 build-wave-2 pages, dated the same way (the owner asked for the high click-through pages to be built now). deferredHubs: topic hubs we are not building for now (hub pages earn almost no search traffic here, see next-50.md); pages under them go out with the Learning Centre (/learn) as their parent and do not have to link the hub. Evening of Oct 16: the 30 pages of data/god-build/next-wave-research.md are dated, the 18 winter earners 2026-10-20 (written now; each goes live the first morning after its fact-check is pushed) and the 12 summer earners 2027-02-01 (written in January so they are indexed and aged before their May-August peak); /learn/kissing-bugs and /learn/wasps-and-bees join deferredHubs (no hub is built just to unblock a page, and the research builds the wasp vs hornet chart instead of the wasps-and-bees hub). Oct 20, 2026: the droppings family (data/god-build/research/droppings-top3.md) is dated 2026-10-20 so each page goes out the morning after its fact-check: rat-droppings and cockroach-droppings brought forward from 2027-01-04, eight new pages added (termite-droppings split from termite-damage; raccoon, bat, squirrel and possum poop; US editions mouse-poop and bed-bug-poop; mouse-urine on 2026-11-02). Pages waiting on a lead photo are written only once it is on record. Oct 21, 2026: mouse-urine moved from 2026-11-02 to 2026-10-21 (its NPS photos went on record Oct 20), and five pages from data/god-build/research/winners-gap.md (gaps #1, #3, #5, #8 and #10: signs-of-carpet-beetles, signs-of-cockroaches, bed-bug-bites-but-no-bed-bugs, oriental-cockroaches, white-cockroach) are dated 2026-10-21, each going out the morning after its fact-check; white-cockroach is written only once a freshly molted cockroach photo is on record. Oct 22, 2026: four more pages from data/god-build/research/winners-gap.md (rows 7, 11, 13 and 19: camel-crickets, reinstated from its Oct 16 gate with crickets-in-house kept on Dec 28 as the general sorter; brown-banded-cockroaches; mice-in-walls; flea-dirt) are dated 2026-10-22, each going out the morning after its fact-check; camel-crickets and flea-dirt are written only once their extra photos are on record. Oct 23, 2026: four pages from data/god-build/research/winners-gap.md are dated 2026-10-23, each going out once its fact-check is pushed: bed-bugs-in-hotels (row 20, new, holiday travel); daddy-long-legs re-aimed at "cellar spider" (the reinstated cellar spider searches; slug kept because live guides and the spider identifier link it) and brought forward from Dec 14; yellow-sac-spiders (adds "white house spider") brought forward from Dec 21; springtails brought forward from 2027-01-04 with its condition removed (two comparable sites win it; an indoor springtail photo went on record in photo batch 11). drain-flies-vs-fruit-flies-vs-gnats (row 15) was planned but held: it would compete with the gnats guide released Oct 20. Oct 23, 2026 (evening): the 18 plan pages of data/god-build/research/volume-20-2026-10-23.md are dated 2026-10-24 (new: what-do-bed-bug-bites-look-like, carpet-beetle-larvae, weevils, jerusalem-crickets and shrews; brought forward: jumping-spiders, orb-weaver-spiders, camel-spiders, joro-spiders, paper-wasps, mud-daubers, wheel-bugs re-aimed at "assassin bug", pill-bugs re-aimed at "roly poly", booklice with next-wave's REPLACE verdict withdrawn, and what-do-termites-look-like from 2027-02-01), except flea-bites and fruit-flies (new US editions) and how-to-get-rid-of-drain-flies (held since Oct 16), dated 2026-10-31 because their Canadian twins are frozen for the Oct 29-30 photo-test read, while the research's two live re-aims (water-bugs-vs-cockroaches, do-ants-bite) are guide edits, not plan pages. Later on Oct 23, 2026: what-do-bed-bug-bites-look-like moves to 2026-11-11 so the Nov 3-10 read of /blog/bed-bug-bites is not clouded (written now, released after the read).
